discovery: 2026-05-17 Chrome-MCP probe of royceattrumbull.com — rrac/caf_v2 popup is backed by a server-callable JSON API (repli360, the rrac vendor).
auth: NONE — works server-side with just Referer/Origin = property domain (verified via curl, no cookies). Full param set required (bare call -> HTTP 500).
response: JSON envelope {single_cta_str, str:<HTML unit table>, ...}; str contains Building Number/Unit Number/Deposits/Total Monthly Leasing Price/Availability rows — parse with existing rrac whitespace-normalize row parser.
bootstrap_call: POST app.repli360.com/admin/template-render (params site_id,property_id,...) renders widget HTML; getUnitListByFloor is the DATA call.
recipe: 1) fetch property HTML 2) extract site_id + all floorPlanIDs 3) POST getUnitListByFloor per floorPlanID with Referer=property 4) parse JSON .str HTML rows
impact: Converts ENTIRE royce-like / rrac / caf_v2 / repli360 cluster from slow fragile DOM-popup (standalone module, not in prod, ~21%) into a deterministic Tier-1 API adapter that IS productionizable in jugnu. No browser/proxy/headless.
verified_on: royceattrumbull.com (site_id 1619, fp A1AL — curl returned rrac table JSON)
open: confirm site_id/floorPlanID extraction generalizes across cluster (only royce verified); finalize required param defaults; wire as jugnu Tier-1 adapter (reuse rrac parser).
